# KPMG

> KPMG is a global professional services firm offering audit, tax, advisory, and AI-driven solutions across 142 countries with expertise in digital transformation, ESG, and industry-specific consulting.

KPMG.com serves as the central hub for KPMG International's thought leadership, service offerings, and career opportunities. The site features comprehensive insights on emerging trends including AI strategy, sustainability, workforce transformation, and value creation across multiple industries.

## Key Topics

- AI and Technology
- ESG and Sustainability
- Digital Transformation
- Value Creation and M&A
- Risk Management and Compliance
- Workforce Strategy
- Professional Services
- Agentic AI
- Climate Finance
- Business Operations
- Strategic Alliances
- Global Tech Report 2026
- Private Enterprise
- Industry Expertise
- Trust and Governance

## Core Company Information

- [KPMG International | Home](https://kpmg.com/xx/en.html): KPMG International homepage with insights on AI, ESG, and transformation
- [About KPMG](https://kpmg.com/xx/en/about.html): KPMG company overview with global reach across 142 countries and 275,000 employees
- [Industries](https://kpmg.com/xx/en/what-we-do/industries.html): KPMG industry expertise overview across automotive, retail, energy, and finance
- [Services](https://kpmg.com/xx/en/what-we-do/services.html): KPMG services overview including tax, legal, advisory, and AI solutions
- [Alliances](https://kpmg.com/xx/en/what-we-do/alliances.html): KPMG strategic alliances with Salesforce, ServiceNow, and technology partners

## Insights and Research

- [Insights](https://kpmg.com/xx/en/our-insights.html): KPMG insights hub covering AI, ESG, operations, risk, and workforce trends

- [Value Creation](https://kpmg.com/xx/en/our-insights/value-creation.html): Value creation insights on M&A, private equity, and fintech with CEO outlook

- [Operations](https://kpmg.com/xx/en/our-insights/operations.html): Operations insights on business efficiency and organizational performance
- [Workforce](https://kpmg.com/xx/en/our-insights/workforce.html): Workforce strategy insights on talent management and skills development
